name: MuzoPlay
releaseNotes: Startup crash hardening: delays and bounds public metadata backfill after launch, catches background metadata/artwork failures instead of terminating the app, samples artwork decoding to avoid memory spikes, and updates the in-app version string. Supersedes the crashing v0.1.28/v0.1.29 line and inherited v0.1.30 build.
description: MuzoPlay is a neutral IPTV/media player for user-supplied playlists. It imports M3U/M3U8 and XMLTV-style guide data, plays live streams with Media3/ExoPlayer or the bundled VLC software decoder, keeps live/movie/show catalog data in a local private database, and intentionally includes no bundled channels, subscriptions, provider credentials, or public stream lists.
